steps.label: What it is
steps.why: Until the cells bind tightly the embryo is only a loose ball; compaction is what turns it into one body.
common_mistakes: Placing compaction at the blastocyst stage. It happens at the morula.
steps.memory_tip: Compaction packs the morula's cells tightly together.
